notes:
Topline: POC failed to convince SREs due to queueing/tail-latency under burst loads. Short, messy timeline below.

- Use-case: realtime chat for live sports + personalised recommendation reranking during peak events (kickoffs, halves). Bursts of 3k-8k concurrent chats; short-lived spikes.
- POC: 2-week Dedicated POC (Dec-Jan) on 4xA100 pool. Baseline OK at steady state (~250 qps) but tail latency spikes >900ms at peak; p50 fine. Observed queueing and retries.
- Tech feedback: "can't tolerate 2s tail latencies during peak windows" (CTO quote on 2025-01-28).
- Redwood actions: suggested autoscale policies, burst pool add-on, aggressive KV/prefix caching, quantized model variants. Ran load tests 2025-01-15 (see POC workbook).
- Security: security requested private deployment + KMS + residency for EU users; that pushed timeline.
- Competitive motion: NimbusAI proposed reserved burst capacity with contractual throughput SLA + blended pricing; finance liked predictable commit.
- Org: internal champion (Lead ML Infra) left in late Jan -> program lost momentum.
- Finance: procurement put enterprise AI spends on pause 2025-02 due to headcount reprioritization.
- Outcome: customer signed with NimbusAI for reserved burst pools; marked closed-lost.

Notes on evidence and attachments: fireflies call ff_2024-11-03_4382a (intro); POC results workbook attached; security FAQ + drivethrough onkms/residency in drive.

Sales shorthand: stalled -> procurement freeze -> closed-lost to Nimbus. Keep relationship for future re-eval after next funding or product launch. Recommended nurture: 6mo cadence + case study re: our burst handling improvements once released.
